abel_character_comb.claim_boundary: The declared literal symmetric three-step Abel character sum is not globally absolutely convergent on the endpoint central contour, and its meromorphic formula has six on-contour pole channels. A naive support-only comb would have rank at most six. This rejects only an uncompleted literal/supported Abel insertion; it does not exclude a source-derived contour deformation, finite-part, regular-plus-residue distribution, other Abel continuation, AFK map, fusion, Stark result, or TCC.

endpoint_strip_and_poles.required_missing_rule: A contour deformation, finite-part, or distributional rule must be derived from the source before the meromorphic Abel formula can be paired with the endpoint kernel.

formal_support_rank_test.conditional_premise: If one replaces the Abel family by only its formal rho=1 support on the central contour, without additional regular/residue data
formal_support_rank_test.consequence: That naive support-only object cannot be an injective all-36 map to T_6. This is not a no-go for a genuine distributional or residue-completed continuation.
formal_support_rank_test.dependence_after_naive_support_replaceme: only on a, not b or r

gate_outcome.remaining_design_problem: Construct an explicitly source-derived distributional or contour continuation that resolves the six character-comb pole channels and retains enough b-dependent data for an all-36 T6 map.

abel_pole_pairs.common_orientation: For every allowed Abel rate and every six m=0 mod4 channels, the rho=u pole is below and the rho=u^(-1) pole is above the real lambda contour.

abel_pole_pairs.residue_derivation: For A_u=(1-u^2)/((1-u*rho)(1-u/rho)) and rho'=-(pi*r/2)*rho, the two simple lambda residues are -2/(pi*r) and +2/(pi*r).

abel_pole_geometry.claim_boundary: The prescribed upper-half-plane A_6 approach canonically orients the six character-comb Abel pole pairs: their two poles approach the central contour from opposite sides with opposite residues. This is only an orientation datum for a prospective contour or distributional continuation. It does not supply a contour pairing with the meromorphic beta kernel, control its infinity tail, prove a lambda-independent boundary value, construct J, match C198, or prove AFK, fusion, Stark, or TCC.
abel_pole_geometry.next_required_construction: Use this fixed paired i0 orientation to define an explicit regular-plus-residue distribution for the full beta kernel, then prove it is well-defined and retains b-dependent all-36 data.

nonpinching_channels.other_logarithm_branches: Their imaginary lambda coordinates remain separated from the real contour as s downarrow 0; this audit makes no claim about other kernel divisor families.

claim_boundary: The source-geodesic i0 boundary value of the declared full-phase, symmetric three-class Abel character comb is a rank-at-most-six delta distribution. It therefore cannot have a linear all-36 intertwiner to C198's distinct T_6 basis. This rejects only that literal completed Abel prescription; it does not rule out a source-derived continuation retaining off-support/derivative/residue data, a different regularization, AFK identification, fusion, Stark, or TCC.

companion_decision.falsifier: Any discrepancy in the pole pair, i0 orientation, residue, delta coefficient, b-independence, rank, C198 target census, or deterministic replay.
companion_decision.known_flaw: The completed boundary discards off-support regular terms and higher jets; the delta support and Abel orientation conventions must remain explicit.
companion_decision.next_action: Preregister a source Laurent/Taylor regular-plus-residue jet, testing delta through delta^5 as the minimal rank-capable candidate and admitting channels only when forced by source expansion or covariance, without fitted coefficients.
companion_decision.reason: The exact full-carrier, phase, pole, and distributional checks settle the declared Abel prescription while explicitly leaving the distinct regular-plus-residue design problem open.
companion_decision.recommendation: Seal C199 as a scoped Abel-boundary obstruction; a derivative-jet regular-plus-residue construction is a distinct frozen method family and therefore a new cycle.

boundary_character_rank.loss: all six b labels collapse for each fixed a
boundary_character_rank.reason: At delta(lambda) support, 2y-Q=0, so alpha_(a,b,z) and hence b drop out; for m=4h, the N=a+2-6r phase is also r-independent.

full_phase_boundary.claim_boundary: The source-geodesic i0 boundary value of the declared full-phase, symmetric three-class Abel character comb is a rank-at-most-six delta distribution. It therefore cannot have a linear all-36 intertwiner to C198's distinct T_6 basis. This rejects only that literal completed Abel prescription; it does not rule out a source-derived continuation retaining off-support/derivative/residue data, a different regularization, AFK identification, fusion, Stark, or TCC.

gate_outcome.remaining_design_problem: Construct a different source-derived endpoint object which retains b-dependent off-support, derivative, or explicitly combined-residue data before any C198 comparison.

no_linear_all36_intertwiner.scope: No linear source-defined J exists for the exact full-phase, symmetric-geodesic Abel boundary distribution derived here. This does not constrain a continuation whose boundary object retains additional off-support, derivative, residue, or non-Abel data.

paired_i0_boundary.normalization_note: This is the character-comb distribution in the lambda coordinate; the equation-(66) contour measure contributes a common nonzero factor and cannot restore b-dependence.

It does not put the meromorphic beta kernel in the seed domain, define its full Abel/Poincare sum at the RM endpoint, produce the source intertwiner J, match C198 values, or prove an AFK, ray, fusion, Stark, or TCC statement.
